messages:
lauren: quick one 11 for the pricing page launch 11 can we run a micro A/B on calculator CTA + FAQ density to reduce low-intent demo noise?
omar: yes. two variants: compact FAQ (single line + expandable) vs full three-bullet FAQ. CTAs: "Get estimate" vs "Talk to sales".
kevin: routing idea: tag leads with variant_id. if lead.intent == 'demo' and lead.variant == 'B' -> route to webinar-invite queue for 48h then sales. else -> sales immed for strong calc signals.
sara: metrics to track: calculator_open, tier_selected, cta_click, webinar_signup, demo_request, support_ticket_keyword=pricing. create a Looker dashboard and short morning report.
lauren: timeline: flags + copy live tomorrow 09:30 PT. monitor 72h. can someone own day-to-day? @sara?
sara: I can. will post AM updates in #marketing-ops.
deploy-bot: feature-flag pricing_micro_ab -> staging (build 789) logs: https://ci.example/build/789
omar: I'll validate webhook and add fallback: if sales_backlog > 8 -> route to nurture and alert ops.
kevin: cms note: upload both FAQ snippets and 2 CTA variants. avoid numeric claims on page; use "tailored estimate in seconds" and link to internal bench.
lauren: perfect. small, measurable, reversible. shipping light.
